items.summary: Macabre Rewards Await in Talebound Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) Madness stirs in Talebound’s darkest stories, and a telling tale isn’t without its just reward. Every Tale Has Its Price: Earn and Spend Bound Silver Outfit yourself with a dark trove of cosmetic rewards using Bound Silver , a Warband-bound currency earned by completing quests, achievements, and progress in the Tales of the Storyteller. Along the way, you’ll also collect Ducats , which can be converted into the resources needed to progress through Talebound, and Bound Silver. Once your tale is complete, return to Quillgrave to trade in your Ducats for Bound Silver and other rewards for your efforts. Spend your Bound Silver on transmog sets, mounts, and other cosmetic rewards through the Talebound store, accessible from the character selection screen or the Game Menu, or by visiting Nib in Quillgrave. Read on for a list of items to add to your collection. items.title: Account Actions For Blackmaw Hold Abuse in WoW: Forever - November 17
items.summary: Account Actions For Blackmaw Hold Abuse in WoW: Forever - November 17 Originally Posted by Blizzard ( Blue Tracker / Official Forums ) As players continue their journey into WoW Forever’s higher-level content, we are closely monitoring the game economy to ensure that gold sources and costs are well balanced. Finding efficient farming spots has always been part of the game, and is how most players have earned their epic mounts since 2004. When a single location proves so lucrative that it overshadows all other sources, we generally adjust it to bring it in line with the rest. Over the past weekend, some players discovered a large group of non-elite enemies in the Blackmaw Hold dungeon that were incorrectly dropping the full amount of dungeon loot that would be expected from an elite. Early yesterday, we addressed this with a hotfix, and since then, we have been investigating the overall economic impact. Players who simply ran Blackmaw Hold a few times and benefited organically from the extra loot did nothing wrong, and no one should worry that they’re putting their account at risk if they accidentally benefit from a bug. But there were a couple hundred players worldwide who recognized that this was unintended and spent significant time exclusively farming that group of enemies.
